next_boundary: a cleared last fire falls due on the first boundary
a tick just past a boundary waits for the next
a late fire waits for the same next boundary
a fire just short of a boundary is due at it
a fire exactly on a boundary waits a whole interval
a fire stamped mid-tick keeps the next boundary
a two-second tick has a two-second grid
an off-grid instant rounds up to the grid
a ten-second cadence lands on a tens boundary
a ten-second fire on its boundary waits ten more
a five-second cadence lands on a fives boundary
